page_data.en:
Appendix " A "

Translation of article which appeared
in the "Slovo" of August 3, 1934.

In yesterday's issue of the "Shanghai Zaria" -
a newspaper always ready to publish any kind of foul
sensation - appeared a lengthy and very ill smelling
"interview" with Mr. F. Gleboff, Chairman of the
notorious "Soro." Every one has already long ago
become tired of tedious discourses of this self-made
Mussolini - or, shall we say, Budenny? (Red Army
Commander, formerly a non-commissioned officer. Translator)
- and, of course, we would not pay any attention to his
painful efforts to say something in order to vindicate
the questionable combination which he, in company with
several intimate friends, is carrying out under the
flag of "Soro" -(The Council of United Russian Organizations
at Shanghai) !!!

But the interview in question, apart from the usual
"cud" it contains, has a definite, specific purpose. It
was not intended merely to provide information or
entertainment for the public on Avenue Joffre. It is rather
a denouncement to the Chinese Authorities of all those
who criticize Soro and its chairman - F. Gleboff.

Indeed, false and libellous complaints against the
"whisperers" leave a strong after-taste of a denouncement.
The remark regarding the "talented cartoonist", whom
F. Gleboff pretends to admire so much, is of the same
nature.

The meaning of the denouncement is this: all critics
and opponents of Soro and its Chairman, F.Gleboff,- i.e.
an overwhelming majority of the local Russian community -
are secretly or openly disloyal to the Chinese Authorities,
will not abide by Chinese Laws and are secret enemies of
China.

F. Gleboff was cautious enough not to mention any
names in the interview in question, but who can guarantee
that certain names will not be obligingly furnished by
page_data.zh:
附录 “ A ”

1934年8月3日《言论报》（Slovo）刊登文章的译文。

在昨天的《上海朝霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）上——这是一份随时准备刊登任何肮脏耸闻的报纸——刊登了一篇 lengthy 且气味极其难闻的与臭名昭著的“SORO”主席 F. 格列博夫（F. Gleboff）先生的“访谈”。每个人早已厌倦了这位自封的墨索里尼——或者我们该说布琼尼？（红军指挥官，前士官。译者注）——的冗长论述，当然，我们也不会关注他为了替他与几位密友以“SORO”（上海联合俄国组织理事会）!!! 的名义进行的可疑勾当辩护而做出的痛苦努力。

但是，所涉访谈除了包含通常的“陈词滥调”外，还有一个明确、具体的目的。它并非仅仅旨在为霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）上的公众提供信息或娱乐。它更像是对所有批评 SORO 及其主席 F. 格列博夫的人向中国当局的告发。

确实，针对“窃窃私语者”的虚假和诽谤性指控留下了强烈的告发余味。关于那位 F. 格列博夫假装非常钦佩的“有才华的漫画家”的评论，性质也是如此。

这种告发的含义是：所有 SORO 及其主席 F. 格列博夫的批评者和反对者——即当地俄侨社群的绝大多数——暗中或公开地对中国当局不忠，不遵守中国法律，并且是中国的秘密敌人。

F. 格列博夫在所涉访谈中谨慎地未提及任何姓名，但谁能保证某些姓名不会由

page_data.en:
-2-
somebody in a Chinese translation to be presented to
the Chinese authorities?
Needless to say that all insinuations regarding
the alleged anti-Chinese feelings in certain circles
of Russian emigrants are nothing but malicious libel
against Russian emigrants and their organizations.
F. Gleboff points out with malevolent satisfaction that
the Russian Emigrants' Committee is at present also
taking steps in order to register with the local branch
of the Kuomintang - a procedure which was some time ago
invented and carried out by the foxy author of the idea
of "Unification of local Russian community by means of
a Chinese whip", the creator and inspirer of Soro -
A.M. Kotenev.
If the Russian Emigrants' Committee has not been
registered with the Kuomintang it was evidently not
because of its opposition to that party or because it
is not loyal to China - a country where we have found
a refuge. During the course of eight years of its
existence (Soro has been in existence only two years)
the Russian Emigrants' Committee has always maintained
the closest contact with the Chinese governmental
institutions in Shanghai as well as in Nanking.
Considering the matter from the viewpoint of common
sense one is naturally perplexed with the question, why
is it necessary for a Russian public organization to
register with a Chinese political party? We do not know
Chinese language, we do not participate in Chinese politics,
we do not know even the fundamental principles of Dr. Sun
Yat Sen's doctrine.
Our organization is of a purely charitable character
and its activities are confined to assisting Russian
emigrants in matters relating to the needs of their
everyday life.
Why, then, is it necessary for such an organization
page_data.zh:
-2-
是否需将某人的中文译本呈交中国当局？
毋庸赘言，所谓俄国侨民某些圈子中据称存在反华情绪的种种暗示，纯属对俄国侨民及其组织的恶意诽谤。F. Gleboff 带着恶意的满足感指出，俄国侨民委员会目前也正采取措施，向国民党地方支部进行注册——这一程序是前不久由那位“借中国鞭子统一当地俄国社群”想法的狡猾炮制者、Soro 的创建者和鼓动者 A.M. Kotenev 所发明并实施的。
如果说俄国侨民委员会未曾向国民党注册，那显然并非因为该委员会反对该党，或对中国——这个我们已找到避难之所的国家——不忠。在其存在的八年期间（Soro 仅存在两年），俄国侨民委员会始终与上海及南京的中国政府机构保持最密切的联系。
从常识角度审视此事，人们自然会对这样一个问题感到困惑：为何一个俄国公共组织有必要向一个中国政党注册？我们不懂中文，不参与中国政治，甚至不了解孙中山先生学说的基本原则。
我们的组织纯属慈善性质，其活动仅限于在日常生活需求方面协助俄国侨民。
那么，为何这样一个组织

page_data.en:
-3-
to be registered with the Kuomintang party? A great
many Chinese officials were also at a loss to understand
this. Nevertheless, Mr. A. M. Koteneff, who at that
time had not yet been cautioned by his chiefs in the
S.M.C., knew what he was doing and registered Soro.
Actually the whole matter boiled down to a certain formal
procedure, which had no practical significance, because,
as was reported by Reuter at that time, the Kuomintang
party had no regulations regarding registration of foreign
organizations.
Chinese official institutions continued to maintain
their absolutely impartial attitude towards all Russian
organizations, which always acted only in the capacity
of mediators for the Chinese Bureau in Nantao with which
all Russian emigrants are to be registered.
During the course of the last year, notwithstanding
a lot of publicity and show up on the part of Koteneff
and Gleboff, Soro - an outcome of bluff - began to go to
pieces. At present there is no one in Soro:- The
National Community, The Union of Army and Navy Men,
Association of Emigrants of Amur Region, Russian Merchants
Association - all more or less active organizations have
severed their connections with Soro.
Who remains there? The "Sokol", x) Doctor Bary's
Society. Anybody else? No!!
Practically, Soro is a company of several intimate
friends - Gleboff, Hohlachkin, the brothers Shendrikoff,
Merkuloff - all of "the same family". Unofficially,
Koteneff with his monocle is also present there.
M.I. Afanassieff practically runs the business. The
latter circumstance has isolated Gleboff from all ex-
military. But what does Lieut.-General Gleboff care
about the ex-military? What is the use of them!
Since sometime recently, the Chinese authorities
have changed their usual impartial attitude and in their
relations with the Russian community prefer to deal with ....
page_data.zh:
-3-
有必要向国民党注册呢？许多中国官员对此也感到不解。然而，当时尚未受到工部局上司警告的 A. M. Koteneff 先生却心知肚明，并为 Soro 办理了注册。实际上，整件事归结为某种形式上的程序，并无实际意义，因为正如路透社当时报道的那样，国民党并无关于外国组织注册的规章。
中国官方机构继续对所有俄国组织保持绝对公正的态度，这些组织始终仅作为南市中国局的中介行事，所有俄国侨民均须在该局注册。
在过去一年中，尽管 Koteneff 和 Gleboff 大加宣传并招摇过市，Soro 这一虚张声势的产物已开始分崩离析。目前 Soro 内已无人代表以下组织：民族共同体、海陆军人联合会、阿穆尔地区侨民协会、俄国商人协会——所有这些或多或少活跃的组织均已切断与 Soro 的联系。
还剩下谁？“索科尔”体育协会 x)，Bary 医生协会。还有别人吗？没有！！
实际上，Soro 只是几个亲密朋友的团伙——Gleboff、Hohlachkin、Shendrikoff 兄弟、Merkuloff——全都属于“同一家族”。非正式地，戴着单片眼镜的 Koteneff 也置身其中。M.I. Afanassieff 实际上掌管着事务。后一情况使 Gleboff 被所有前军人孤立。但中将 Gleboff 在乎前军人吗？他们有什么用！
最近以来，中国当局改变了以往公正的态度，在与俄国社群的关系中更倾向于与……

page_data.en:
-4-
....Soro !!!
With the very same Soro, with which all larger
Russian organizations have severed their connections;
at the time, when this combination of several selfish
individuals is arousing not only "whisper" but general
indignation of the Russian community. This sudden
decision of the Chinese authorities is astonishing.
Of course, the Chinese authorities have the full
right to choose any channel they please of maintaining
relations with Russians, and we were only grateful to
them for their impartial attitude towards us. But if
at present the Chinese authorities began for reasons
unknown to patronize Soro - we cannot but raise
a voice of protest.
We are absolutely loyal to China, Chinese laws
and institutions. We are prepared to give every
assistance to the authorities in all matters concerning
in any way our life in China.
But we protest most emphatically out of motives
of moral and social order against the attempt on the
part of individuals from Soro to exercise, in the name
of the Chinese authorities, a power over the Russian
community, for which they have not the necessary
confidence of the latter.
X) Translator's note. Sporting association "Sokol"
also severed its connections with"Soro."
page_data.zh:
-4-
……Soro 打交道！！！
正是与这个 Soro 打交道，而所有较大的俄国组织都已与其断绝联系；就在这一小撮自私个人的组合不仅引起“私下议论”，而且激起俄国社群普遍愤慨之时。中国当局的这一突然决定令人震惊。
当然，中国当局完全有权选择任何他们喜欢的渠道来维持与俄国人的关系，我们曾对其对我们的公正态度深表感激。但如果目前中国当局出于未知原因开始庇护 Soro，我们不得不提出抗议。
我们对中国、中国法律及机构绝对忠诚。我们准备在涉及我们在华生活的任何事项上向当局提供一切协助。
但出于道德和社会秩序的动机，我们最强烈地抗议 Soro 中的某些个人试图以中国当局的名义对俄国社群行使权力，因为他们并未获得该社群的必要信任。
X) 译者注。体育协会“索科尔”也已切断与“Soro”的联系。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, APRIL 11, 1935

A GOOD MOVE

The news that the White Russian
Community has been able to adjust
its differences will be welcomed by
those who followed the schisms of
recent years with any degree of
interest. For a number of years
unity was despaired of in the minds
of those who realized how apparent-
ly irreconcilable were the views of
the opposing parties. Attempts were
made from time to time to reach a
settlement, but at the last moment
there was always some question over
which a nearly completed rapproche-
ment would again break down. It
would not be at all proper at this
juncture to endeavour to assess the
blame for the lamentable state of
affairs which existed: indeed it
might generally be conceded that the
disputants were perfectly genuine in
their desires to serve their com-
munity, and it was a difference of
methods rather than one of prin-
ciple which kept various sections at
arms length. It speaks well for the
various leaders that as a result of
much negotiation it has been pos-
sible to bring about that very union
which at one time seemed impos-
sible. It is eminently desirable that
a community so strong in Shanghai
as the White Russians should be
banded together in as formal and
complete a manner as possible.
Once this is done it should be able
to speak with the authority which
so numerically strong a section of
the population should possess. Not
only that but such unity follows
modern trends and should help to
make the Russian community infin-
itely more influential than it has
been in the past and endow it with
a voice having the full weight of
unified authority behind it.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，1935年4月11日，星期四

明智之举

白俄社群能够消除分歧的消息，将受到那些对近年来的分裂局面抱有某种程度关注的人士的欢迎。多年来，那些意识到对立双方观点似乎不可调和的人心中已对团结不抱希望。不时有人尝试达成和解，但在最后关头，总会出现某个问题，致使几近完成的和解再次破裂。在此刻试图评估造成这种令人遗憾局面的责任归属是完全不恰当的；事实上，人们普遍可以承认，争端各方在服务其社群的愿望上是完全真诚的，使各派别保持距离的是方法上的差异，而非原则上的分歧。各位领导人经过大量谈判，最终实现了曾经看似不可能的联合，这充分证明了他们的能力。像白俄这样在上海实力雄厚的社群，尽可能以正式和完整的方式团结起来，是极其可取的。一旦做到这一点，它便能够以如此庞大的人口群体所应拥有的权威发声。不仅如此，这种团结顺应现代潮流，应有助于使俄国社群的影响力比过去无限增强，并赋予其背后拥有统一权威充分分量的声音。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, APRIL 10, 1935

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRY.
D 5002
Date 10 / 4 / 35

RUSSIAN COLONY
UNITED

Joint Organization Formed
to Represent Community

On Monday evening at the new premises of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118 Moulmein Road, there took place an important meeting of the representatives of all Russian organizations in Shanghai, about 60 people being present. The matter discussed by them was of paramount importance—that of the unification of the Russian colony in Shanghai.

Having no country or their own, backed by no government or by a recognized consular official, for many years the White Russians in Shanghai, being left to themselves have been divided into many organizations of rival groupings, each claiming the right to represent the community as a whole. Needless to say, the competition of that sort was harmful and led nowhere and the Russian colony remained without an authoritative representative who would enjoy the general support in the White Russian circles.

Preceded by private conversations of the leading members of the colony, which brought complete accord and understanding, the meeting was to settle the matter officially. And more weight to that outward sign of reconciliation was added by the fact that the meeting started under the chairmanship of the Rev. Bishop John, who in a few short words expressed his deepest satisfaction at seeing the Russian community reconciled and wielded together by the frank desire to do away with the former differences.

Having blessed the gathering the Bishop departed and the chair was taken by Dr. D. I. Kasakoff, President of the Russian Orthodox Confraternity. After a few words of greetings Dr. Kasakoff invited Mr. N. Y. Fomin to speak. He explained to all present that extremely hard times and circumstances urgently demanded the fullest possible unification of all social and charitable work in the Russian community. Mr. Fomin's address met with unanimous approval of the audience. Without further delay the necessary resolutions were passed, whereby:—

Mr. Ch. Metzler was elected to be the official Representative of the Russian Emigrants' Community in Shanghai.

A general committee of the Russian Emigrants' Association, Shanghai of about 25 members was appointed. Mr. N. Y. Fomin was elected chairman.

While Mr. Metzler will represent the White Russian community in all dealings with the Chinese, foreign and municipal authorities, Mr. Fomin and his committee will attend to all internal needs of the Russian colony.

$2,
For full
report in due

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. M. 登记处。
D 5002
日期 1935年4月10日

俄侨社区
联合

组建联合组织
以代表该社区

周一晚，在莫利爱路（Moulmein Road）118号俄侨委员会新址，举行了一次重要的会议，与会者为上海所有俄人组织的代表，出席人数约60人。他们讨论的事项至关重要，即上海俄侨社区的统一问题。

由于没有自己的国家，也没有政府或公认的领事官员作为后盾，多年来，上海的白俄人士处于自生自灭的状态，分裂为许多相互竞争的组织团体，每个团体都声称有权代表整个社区。毋庸赘言，这种竞争有害无益，毫无结果，导致俄侨社区缺乏一位能在白俄圈子中获得普遍支持的权威代表。

在此次会议之前，社区主要成员进行了私下交谈，达成了完全的一致与谅解，此次会议旨在正式解决此事。此外，会议在主教约翰（Rev. Bishop John）的主持下开始，他为这一和解的外在标志增添了分量，主教简短致辞，表达了对看到俄侨社区因坦诚希望消除以往分歧而重归于好、团结一致的深切满意。

主教祝福集会后离去，由俄罗斯东正教兄弟会主席 D. I. Kasakoff 博士接任主席。Kasakoff 博士致欢迎辞后，邀请 N. Y. Fomin 先生发言。他向在场所有人解释，极其艰难的时局和环境迫切要求俄侨社区的所有社会和慈善工作尽可能全面统一。Fomin 先生的讲话获得了听众的一致赞同。随即通过了必要的决议，内容如下：—

选举 Ch. Metzler 先生为上海俄侨社区的官方代表。

任命一个由约25名成员组成的上海俄侨协会总委员会。选举 N. Y. Fomin 先生为主席。

Metzler 先生将在与中国、外国及工部局当局的所有交涉中代表白俄社区，而 Fomin 先生及其委员会将负责处理俄侨社区的所有内部事务。

$2,
完整报告
稍后提交。新组织
将如何影响
S.O.L.O. 的地位？
JMS
1935年4月10日
O.S.D. Pinkerton

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch Station, 1
REPORT
Date April 9, 1935.

Subject Establishment of General Committee of the Russian Emigrants
Association in Shanghai.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by B. B. Suvorov O. I.

Between 5.30 p.m. and 6.30 p.m. on April 8, 1935, a
meeting of representatives of 41 Russian organizations in
Shanghai was held in the premises of the Russian Emigrants
Committee, House 1, No. 118 Moulmein Road, to discuss the question
of appointing a representative of the local Russian community
as well as establishing a central organ unifying the community.
Dr. D. I. Kasakoff, Chairman of the Russian Orthodox
Confraternity, presided.
The following resolution was unanimously passed:-
"Russian public organizations in Shanghai hereby declare
that they recognize
a) Mr. Ch. E. Metzler as the representative of the
Russian Emigrants Community in Shanghai and
b) the General Committee of the Russian Emigrants
Association - as the central organ which is competent
to deal with internal matters of the community."
Captain N. G. Fomin was then unanimously elected
President of the General Committee of the Russian Emigrants
Association consisting of 30 members, while Rev. Bishop John of
Shanghai was elected Honorary President of the Committee.
A detailed report on this matter will be submitted
in due course.

A ||

G. Prokopiew
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch). S2.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2. Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. B. REGISTRY
V. D J002
Date June 17, 1933.

Subject (in full) Comment on article re: local Russian community, which
appeared in the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury".

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached cutting from the "Shanghai
Evening Post & Mercury" of June 13, 1933 containing article
entitled "Red Refugees from Russia Turn Ardent Whites Here",

I have to state that with the exception of a few details intended
to catch the reader's eye, the information contained in the
article in question is based on a statement of Mr. Ch. Metzler,
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee.

This statement (copy attached) contains a brief outline
of the history of this body since 1926 when it was established
as well as an account of the work performed during the period
1926 - 1932 and during the first four months of 1933.

Although the exact data regarding the number of Russian
Emigrants in Shanghai are not available, the figures given in
Mr. Metzler's statement (flagged) give an idea of the steady
growth of the local Russian community during the past eleven
years.

So far, there are no signs that a large influx of
Russians from Harbin can be expected here in the near future.

Among the arrivals from Harbin there were persons who
until recently were registered as Soviet citizens in order to
keep their jobs, but who took out emigrants' passport prior to
departure from Harbin.

[Signature]
19/6
Officer i/c Special Branch.

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

Commr. of Police.

主题（全文） 对《上海晚邮报与水星报》刊登的关于本地俄国侨民社区文章的评论。

由 D. S. Prokofiev (音译) 撰写。经由 [签名] 转发

关于附上的1933年6月13日《上海晚邮报与水星报》剪报，其中包含题为“来自俄国的红色难民在此转变为狂热的白俄”的文章，

我必须指出，除了少数旨在吸引读者眼球的细节外，该文章所包含的信息基于俄国侨民委员会主席 Ch. Metzler (音译) 先生的声明。

该声明（副本附后）简要概述了该机构自1926年成立以来的历史，以及1926年至1932年期间和1933年前四个月所开展的工作。

虽然无法获得关于上海俄国侨民数量的确切数据，但 Metzler (音译) 先生声明中给出的数字（已标记）让人了解到过去十一年来本地俄国侨民社区的稳定增长。

目前，没有迹象表明在不久的将来会有大量俄国人从哈尔滨涌入此地。

在从哈尔滨抵达的人员中，有些人直到最近为了保住工作仍登记为苏联公民，但在离开哈尔滨前领取了侨民护照。

BRIEF STATEMENT
of seven years' activity of the Russian Emigrants' Committee
(1926 to 1932 inclusively)

At the time when, after the official recognition by China
of the Soviet Government, the offices of the former Imperial Rus-
sian Consulate General in Shanghai were closed, the numerous Rus-
sian colony in this city were faced with the necessity to create
an organisation which would substitute the closed official establish-
ment and act as an intermediary between the numerous Russian emig-
rants and the Chinese authorities as well as the Foreign Consulates
and Municipalities in this city as regards the different require-
ments of the Russian emigrants, such as issuing of passports to
them, foreign and local visas, certificates, recommendations etc.

This question was after a certain time quite successfully
solved by the establishment in the year 1926 under the chairmanship
of Mr.V.Grosse, with Mr.Ch.Keteler as vice-chairman, of the Rus-
sian Emigrants' Committee, which resumed as far as possible, the
functions of the former Russian Consulate.

The Russian Emigrants' Committee includes a Representative
of the Russian Bishop of Shanghai and with the Committee are allied
the following Russian Organisations:

简要陈述
俄国侨民委员会七年活动情况
（1926年至1932年，含首尾两年）

在中国正式承认苏联政府，前沙皇俄国驻上海总领事馆关闭之时，本市众多的俄国侨民面临着建立一个组织的必要性，该组织将取代已关闭的官方机构，并作为众多俄国侨民与中国当局以及本市外国领事馆和市政当局之间的中介，处理俄国侨民的各种需求，如为他们签发护照、外国和本地签证、证明书、推荐信等。

经过一段时间后，这个问题通过于1926年在 V. Grosse (音译) 先生担任主席、Ch. Keteler (音译) 先生担任副主席的情况下成立俄国侨民委员会而得到相当成功的解决，该委员会尽可能恢复了前俄国领事馆的职能。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, June 13, 1933

Red Refugees From Russia
Turn Ardent Whites Here

Shanghai Colony Expects Increase In Numbers
From Present Total Of 16,000 To 25,000
Soon; Many Flee Harbin Hard Times

The seeds of Communism will never grow in the soil of one large group of Shanghai residents—the White Russians.
Conditions in the North, the state of unrest and uncertainty in Manchuria and Jehol, are causing an increasing influx of anti-Communist Russians into Shanghai and local Russian organizations are taxed to the limit to provide for them, according to Mr. C. E. Metzler, Chairman of the Russian Refugees' Committee.
Many of the new arrivals have lived under the Red Flag until very recently—ardently singing the Internationale, chanting the Bolshevik huzzahs—until the moment they were safe from Communist power.

16,000 Emigrees Here
There are now about 16,000 white Russians living in Shanghai and it is expected this number will increase to 25,000 in a short time. Living and working conditions are becoming more difficult for the 80,-000 white Russians in Harbin and many of them are saving their coppers to move to Shanghai, it was stated.
They have no Consulate to which they may appeal for aid, no flag to which they may appeal for protection. Some of them are taking out Chinese citizenship but the majority remain Men and Women Without a Country, the Lost Tribes of Russia.

Titled Russians Must Toil
Most of the titled Russians went to European capitals after the Revolution but some came to Shanghai, and now live here as humble persons eking out an existence like their Russian brothers, according to Mr. Metzler. The majority of Russians in China came from Siberia and the Volga district.
One indication of the loyalty of Russians to the old order of things is the number of organizations functioning in Shanghai to preserve the ties with their former glory: such groups as the Union of Former Members of Regiment of General Annenkoff, Standard and Banner Keepers of Transbaillian Cossacks, Russian Cossacks Union, Union of Former Members of Ural Regiment and Eger Regiment, Union of Musketeers, and others.

Over 50 Organizations
There are well over 50 Russian organisations functioning in Shanghai engaged in many social, religious, charity, medical and educational activities. In addition there is in Shanghai a representative of the Grand Duke Cyril of Russia and some day when the Communist regime is overthrown—and every white Russian believes that event is "just around the corner"—they expect to return to their native land.
The emigration of Russians to China really started with the fall of Admiral Kolchak's Far Eastern Russian Government. This first Russian Colony started in the Blagoveshchensk District and was later moved in the direction of Aventa Joffre.

One Of The First
Mr. Metzler, who was a legal official in the Russian Government, was one of the first to move to the Avenue Joffre district and he remembers the time when that neighborhood was just farm land. Now it is turning into a busy shopping district.
Since 1922 there have been 15,415 white Russians registered by the Russian Emigrants Committee, of whom 6,199 women and 2,250 children.

Drop In 1932
A large drop in the number of emigrants occurred in 1932 when only 1560 newcomers arrived in Shanghai. The previous year there were 2625 emigrants registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee. There are undoubtedly many Russians who have friends here and did not report to Committee Headquarters and no exact figure can be given.
The Russian Emigrants Committee was organized by local Russians at the time when the former Imperial Russian Consulate General in Shanghai was closed after official recognition by China of the Soviet Government.

Does Consulate's Duties
The Committee performed much of the work formerly done by the Imperial Consulate and acted as intermediary between the numerous Russian emigrants and the Chinese authorities as well as the Foreign Consulates and Municipalities in Shanghai as regards the different requirements of the Russian emigrants such as passports, foreign and local visas, certificates and recommendations. In addition it helped to care for destitute arrivals and find jobs for them.
Organization of the Committee was completed in 1926 with Mr. V. Groce as chairman, and Mr. Ch. Metzler as Vice-Chairman, and allied itself with the following organizations:

List of Organizations
Russian Orthodox Confraternity, Russian Relief Association, Russian Educational Society, Union of former members of Manchurian Detachment, Union of former members of Ural Regiment, Union of former members of Eger Regiment, National Religious Confraternity of Turks and Tartars, Russian National Society (Vera, Tsar and Narod), Union of Cross Bearers, Union of Musketeers, Society of New Born Russia, Union of Russian Students, Uralo-Siberian Labor Society, Russian Labor Company of British Defence Force, Russian Labor Company of Advance Ordnance Depot, R.D.P., Literary Artistic Society, National Union of Stage Workers, Russian Hospital, Russian Commercial School, First Russian School, Russian Laborers Federation Standard and Banner Keepers of Transbaillian Cossacks, Russian National Religious Committee, Union of former members of Regiment of General Annenkoff, Russian Merchant Marine Association, Union of former cadets of the Habarovsk Military College, Committee of Assistance to the Home for Aged Ladies.

Besides the above the Russian Emigrants' Committee is working in close contact with the Representative of the Grand Duke Cyril of Russia, with the Russian Jewish Community in Shanghai (Cheil Moishe Synagogue), with the Russian Cossacks Union, with the Russian Military Invalids Union, League of the Russian Women's, Russian Merchant of Manufacturers Association, Russian Juridical Society, Emigrants' Society of Amur, National Russian Boy-Scouts Association, Union of former Members of Ijevsk and Votkinsk Brigade, Russian Ladies Relief Association, Central Benevolent Committee of the Bishop's Orthodox Church, Russian Schools' Friends Society, Russian Medical Society, Union of Cabinet Employees, Association of former Members of the 1st Fusiliers Brigade, Union of former Members of the Far Eastern Volunteers and with some other Russian neutral Organizations.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1933年6月13日，星期二

来自俄罗斯的红色难民
在此转变为狂热的白俄

上海侨民界预计人数将很快
从目前的16,000人增至25,000人；
许多人逃离哈尔滨的艰难时世

共产主义的种子绝不会在上海一大群居民——白俄——的土壤中生根发芽。
据俄国难民委员会主席C. E. 梅茨勒（C. E. Metzler）先生称，北方局势、满洲和热河的不安与不确定状态，正导致越来越多的反共俄国人涌入上海，当地的俄国组织在为他们提供援助方面已不堪重负。
许多新来者直到最近还生活在红旗之下——热情地高唱《国际歌》，欢呼布尔什维克万岁——直到他们摆脱共产党权力的那一刻为止。

此地有16,000名流亡者
目前约有16,000名白俄居住在上海，预计这一数字将在短时间内增加到25,000人。据悉，哈尔滨80,000名白俄的生活和工作条件日益艰难，其中许多人正积攒零钱以便迁往上海。
他们没有领事馆可以求助，没有国旗可以寻求保护。有些人正在申请中国国籍，但大多数人仍然是“无国籍男女”，即俄罗斯的“失落部落”。

有头衔的俄国人必须劳作
梅茨勒先生表示，大多数有头衔的俄国人在革命后前往欧洲各国首都，但也有些人来到上海，如今像他们的俄国同胞一样，作为卑微之人勉强维持生计。在华俄国人多数来自西伯利亚和伏尔加地区。
俄国人忠于旧秩序的一个迹象是，上海有许多组织在运作，以保持与他们昔日荣光的联系：这类团体包括阿年科夫将军团前成员联盟、外贝加尔哥萨克旗手与标手联盟、俄国哥萨克联盟、乌拉尔团和埃格尔团前成员联盟、火枪手联盟等。

超过50个组织
上海有50多个俄国组织在运作，从事许多社会、宗教、慈善、医疗和教育活动。此外，上海还有一位俄国基里尔大公（Grand Duke Cyril）的代表。总有一天，当共产主义政权被推翻时——每个白俄都相信这一事件“指日可待”——他们期望返回祖国。
俄国人向中国的移民实际上始于高尔察克海军上将的远东俄国政府垮台之时。第一个俄国侨民聚居区始于布拉戈维申斯克区，后来向霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）方向迁移。

首批移民之一
梅茨勒先生曾是俄国政府的法律官员，是最早搬至霞飞路地区的人之一，他记得那时该街区还只是农田。如今，它正变成一个繁忙的商业区。
自1922年以来，俄国流亡者委员会登记的白俄人数为15,415人，其中妇女6,199人，儿童2,250人。

1932年人数下降
1932年移民人数大幅下降，当年仅有1,560名新来者抵达上海。前一年在俄国流亡者委员会登记的移民有2,625人。毫无疑问，有许多俄国人在这里有朋友，并未向委员会总部报告，因此无法给出确切数字。
俄国流亡者委员会是由当地俄国人组织的，当时正值中国政府正式承认苏联政府后，前沙皇俄国驻上海总领事馆关闭之际。

履行领事馆职责
该委员会承担了许多以前由沙皇领事馆所做的工作，并作为众多俄国流亡者与中国当局以及上海的外国领事馆和工部局之间的中介，处理俄国流亡者的各种需求，如护照、外国和本地签证、证书和推荐信。此外，它还帮助照顾贫困的抵达者并为他们寻找工作。
委员会的组织工作于1926年完成，由V. 格罗斯（V. Groce）先生担任主席，Ch. 梅茨勒（Ch. Metzler）先生担任副主席，并与以下组织建立了联系：

组织名单
俄国东正教兄弟会、俄国救济协会、俄国教育协会、满洲支队前成员联盟、乌拉尔团前成员联盟、埃格尔团前成员联盟、突厥人和鞑靼人民族宗教兄弟会、俄国民族协会（信仰、沙皇与人民）、十字架佩戴者联盟、火枪手联盟、新生俄罗斯协会、俄国学生联盟、乌拉尔-西伯利亚劳工协会、英国防卫部队俄国劳工连、前方军械库俄国劳工连、R.D.P.、文学艺术协会、舞台工作者全国联盟、俄国医院、俄国商业学校、第一俄国学校、俄国劳动者联合会、外贝加尔哥萨克旗手与标手联盟、俄国民族宗教委员会、阿年科夫将军团前成员联盟、俄国商船协会、哈巴罗夫斯克军事学院前学员联盟、老年妇女之家援助委员会。

除上述组织外，俄国流亡者委员会还与俄国基里尔大公代表、上海俄国犹太社区（Cheil Moishe Synagogue）、俄国哥萨克联盟、俄国军人伤残者联盟、俄国妇女联盟、俄国制造商协会、俄国法律协会、阿穆尔流亡者协会、全俄童子军协会、伊热夫斯克和沃特金斯克旅前成员联盟、俄国女士救济协会、主教东正教会中央慈善委员会、俄国学校之友协会、俄国医学会、内阁雇员联盟、第一步枪兵旅前成员协会、远东志愿军前成员联盟以及其他一些俄国中立组织保持密切联系。

8th June, 1933

J.R.Jones,Esquire,
Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Dear Sir,

In view of the circular letter of 1st June 1933
issued by the so-called Council of the United Russian Pub-
lic Organization ( 442 Avenue Joffre ),I have the honour
to inform you that the Russian Emigrants' Committee and
the Russian Organizations allied with the Committee,as per
list herewith attached,are taking no part whatsoever in the
activities of the above-mentioned Council.

I have the honour to,
Dear Sir,
Your obedient servant,

( Ch. Metzler )
Chairman,
Russian Emigrants'Committee
former
Vice-Consul for Russia.

1933年6月8日

J.R. Jones 先生，
秘书，
上海工部局。

尊敬的先生：

鉴于所谓“俄国公共组织联合委员会”（霞飞路 442号）于 1933年 6月 1日发出的通函，本人荣幸地通知您，俄国侨民委员会及附名单所列与该委员会结盟的俄国组织，均不参与上述委员会的任何活动。

谨此致意，
尊敬的先生，
您顺从的仆人，

( Ch. Metzler )
主席，
俄国侨民委员会
前
俄国副领事。

25002
（印：REGISTERED L.D. 31/3 32.）

Translation of a mimeographed letter dated March 22,
1932 from one Doo Tien Yih (杜天一) addressed to the
Russian Relief Society, No.6 Hongkong Road.

Gentlemen,

Prompted with a sincerity of personal and
universal salvation as well as with an undaunted
spirit, and in accordance with the principle of classify-
ing the people as a unit and the natural acknowledgement
of existence and privilege, I have resolved and shall
undertake the task of settling disorders and annihilating
all prejudices in order to secure justice and stability
for mankind. I am of the opinion that the unity of the
people is right whereas the unity of a party is wrong.
One can struggle for justice, but must be broad-minded.
As Party members are composed of people, why should they
oppose the Party ?

The world has been thrown into a state of
disorder which displays a lack of an undaunted spirit
and grievance of excess of modern procedure . If you
second my proposal, I am willing to tell what I know in
order to undertake this grand task and I shall look
forward for your advice.

Sd: Doo Tien Yih.

Note: Posted on 22/3/32 at the C.P.O.Branch Office,41 Yu Yuen Rd,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
25002
（印：挂号信 L.D. 32年3月31日。）

1932年3月22日，杜天一（Doo Tien Yih）致香港路6号俄国救济会的一封油印信的译文。

诸位先生：

出于个人与普世救赎的诚意，以及无畏的精神，并依据将人民视为一个整体、相互承认生存与特权的原则，我已决心并将承担平息混乱、消除一切偏见的任务，以确保人类的正义与稳定。我认为，人民的团结是正确的，而政党的团结是错误的。人们可以为正义而斗争，但必须心胸宽广。既然党员由人组成，他们为何要反对党呢？

世界已陷入一种混乱状态，显示出缺乏无畏精神以及对现代程序过度的不满。如果你们附议我的提议，我愿意告知我所知的一切，以承担这项宏伟任务，并期待你们的建议。

签署：杜天一。

注：1932年3月22日投寄于上海愚园路41号中央邮局分局。

page_data.en:
BRIEF STATEMENT
of six years' activity of the Russian Emigrants' Committee
( 1926 to 1931 inclusively )

At the time when, after the official recognition by China
of the Soviet Government, the offices of the former Imperial Russian
Consulate General in Shanghai were closed, the numerous Russian co-
lony in this city were faced with the necessity to create an organi-
zation which would substitute the closed official establishment and
act as an intermediary between the numerous Russian emigrants and
the Chinese authorities as well as the Foreign Consulates in this
city as regards the different requirements of the Russian emigrants,
such as issuing of passports to them, foreign and local visas, cer-
tificates, recommendations etc.

This question was after a certain time quite successfully
solved by the establishment in the year 1926 under the chairmanship
of Mr. V. Grosse, with Mr. Ch. Metzler as vice-chairman, of the Rus-
sian Emigrants' Committee, which resumed as far as possible, the
functions of the former Russian Consulate.

The Russian Emigrants' Committee includes a Representative
of the Russian Bishop of Shanghai and with the Committee are allied
the following Russian Organizations:

Russian Orthodox Confraternity,
Russian Relief Association,
Russian Educational Society,
Union of former members of Manchurian Detachment,
Union of former members of Ural Regiment,
Union of former members of Eger Regiment,
National Religious Confraternity of Turks & Tartars,
Russian National Society (Vera, Tsar and Narod),
Union of Cross Bearers,
Union of Banketovtsi,
Society of the New Russia,
Union of Russian Lawyers,
Russo-Chinese Labour Society,
Russian Labour Company of British Defence Force,
Russian Labour Company of Advance Ordnance Depot, R.A.F.,

俄国侨民委员会六年活动简报
（1926年至1931年，含首尾两年）

在中国正式承认苏维埃政府后，前沙俄驻上海总领事馆关闭之际，本市众多的俄国侨民面临着建立一个组织的必要性，该组织将取代已关闭的官方机构，并作为众多俄国侨民与中国当局及本市外国领事馆之间的中介，处理俄国侨民的各种需求，如为他们签发护照、外国及本地签证、证明书、推荐信等。

经过一段时间，这一问题得到了相当成功的解决，即于1926年在 V. Grosse 先生担任主席、Ch. Metzler 先生担任副主席的情况下成立了俄国侨民委员会，该委员会尽可能恢复了前俄国领事馆的职能。

俄国侨民委员会包括上海俄国主教的代表，并与以下俄国组织联合：

RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS
COMMITTEE
Question of Successor To Late
Mr. V. Grosse

The suggestion put forward by
certain Russian organizations that
the Shanghai Municipal Council
should appoint a successor to the
late Mr. V. Grosse, who was chair-
man of the Russian Emigrants

Shanghai Municipal Council at
Wednesday's meeting. The Coun-

appoint no individual Russian resi-

be made to the Council by an or-

Foreign Affairs, C&S.B Station. File No. Date July 31, 1942

SUBJECT: Communication dated 29-7-42 from Mr. V.L. Fri-
sovsky containing complaints against the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee.

The attached communication is Mr. Mr. V.L. Fri-
sovsky's reaction to Order No.6 issued by the Russian Emi-
grants Committee on 24-7-42 whereby he and another Russian
named N.G. Yakovleff have been struck off the Committee's
Register for " an attempt to hinder the work carried out
by the Committee in National Organizations of Russian
Youth and for insubordination to the Committee". Discreet
enquiries show that, before applying this measure to the
individuals in question, the Committee has obtained the
sanction of the Japanese and Chinese Authorities control-
ling its activities as well the approval of a special con-
ference of representatives of various Russian public or-
ganizations.

It would appear from a perusal of the communi-
cation that whatever the nature and truth of Mr. Frisov-
sky's complaints and allegations against the Russian Emi-
grants Committee and its Chairman may be, they do not con-
stitute a matter that would call for an interference on
the part of the S.M.Police, and that Mr. Frisovsky's perso-
nal differences with the Committee should be settled di-
rect between the parties concerned.

It therefore respectfully suggested that Mr.
Frisovsky be verbally informed in accordance with the
above.

A. Prokopiev
D.I.

外事科，刑事与特别分部（C&S.B）分站。档案号。日期 1942年7月31日

事由：V.L. Frisovsky先生于1942年7月29日来函，内含对俄国侨民委员会的投诉。

所附信函是V.L. Frisovsky先生对俄国侨民委员会于1942年7月24日发布的第6号命令的反应，根据该命令，他和另一名名为N.G. Yakovleff的俄国人因“企图阻碍委员会在俄国青年国家组织中进行的工作以及不服从委员会”而被从委员会名册中除名。经谨慎查询显示，在对相关人员采取此措施之前，委员会已获得控制其活动的日本和中国当局的许可，以及由各俄国公共组织代表组成的特别会议的批准。

从对该信函的通读来看，无论Frisovsky先生对俄国侨民委员会及其主席的投诉和指控的性质及真实性如何，它们并不构成需要上海公共租界警务处（S.M.Police）介入的事项，且Frisovsky先生与委员会之间的个人分歧应由有关各方直接解决。

因此，谨建议按上述内容口头告知Frisovsky先生。

副督察（D.I.）

Sir,
From the enclosed decree of the Russian Emigrants Committee
it is evident that I am excluded from the lists and am ordered to
return my passport within three days, being accused of insubordination
to the Emigrants Committee and of an attempt to hinder the activities
of the Committee.
All those accusations are groundless as:
On the 10th July a.c.I have been summoned to the Emigrants Committee
/the summons enclosed/and Mr.Serestmikoff proposed to me to discontinue
the activity of the Military Scientific Association.The Army and Navy
existing since 1926. This demand though unlawful,I followed,as is
apparent from the enclosed copy of my letter to the Chairman of the
Committee Mr.Serestmikoff,and his receipt of this letter on the envelope
where I am informing him of the discontinuation of the Society's
activities.
During the conversation on the 10th of July a.c.I said to Mr.Serestmikoff
that I am continually persecuted by the Committee although I did not
commit any crime and never was locked in Shanghai prisons for criminal
activities.I also mentioned to Mr.Serestmikoff that I am on the
Committee's lists for the last 20 years,honestly performing all the
duties of an emigrant.I also expressed my surprise that my demands to
dismiss from the Remg School a Russian Emigrant N.J.Reiman,and excluding
him from the Committee and summoning him to the Chinese Court for
debauching of the boys from this School/ beginning with 10 years old
boys/ by pederasty,/sexual intercourse of Reiman with small boys/

阁下，
从随附的俄国侨民委员会法令中可以明显看出，我被从名册中除名，并被责令在三天内交回护照，罪名是不服从侨民委员会以及企图阻碍委员会的活动。
所有这些指控都是毫无根据的，因为：
本月10日，我接到侨民委员会的传唤（传票已附），Serestmikoff先生向我提议停止自1926年以来存在的陆海军军事科学协会的活动。尽管这一要求是非法的，我还是遵照执行了，这从随附的我给委员会主席Serestmikoff先生的信件副本以及他在信封上签收收到此信的记录中可以明显看出，我在信中通知他停止该协会的活动。
在本月10日的谈话中，我对Serestmikoff先生说，尽管我没有犯下任何罪行，也从未因犯罪活动被关进上海的监狱，但我一直受到委员会的迫害。我还向Serestmikoff先生提到，我在委员会的名册上已有20年，诚实地履行着作为侨民的所有义务。我还表示惊讶的是，我要求将一名俄国侨民N.J. Reiman从雷米学校（Remg School）开除，将其从委员会除名，并因该男子对该校男孩（从10岁的男孩开始）进行鸡奸（Reiman与小男孩发生性关系）而将他传唤至中国法庭的要求，

were left by the Committee without reply and that as prove of Reiman's
crimes I presented to the Committee copy of Russian boys from the Remy
School,ravished by Reiman testimony given by them to the French judge and
after the Court's Section the testimonials were returned to me by my
lawyer,Mr. D'Auction de Ruffé.
I still keep those testimonials.In my letter book I have all the receipts
of the Emigrants'Committee,which prove that all my depositions and testi-
monials were received by the Committee. But neither Mr.Ivanoff,nor Messrs.
Serestmikoff and Savintzeff stood up in defence of Russian children from
a Russian criminal,Reiman summoned by the Chinese court on the 4th April
1941 for ravishing through the aims of a 17 years old boy Skobin /orphan./
The court examined the case only by half.Mr.Reiman gave his testimony,but
the Court discontinued the procedure,because Skobin was under age and an
orphan.In the Court's decision the Judge stated that the case could be
continued by myself,Frisovsky,if my guardian's documents would be approved
by the Supreme Court.
I could not prosecute because my lawyer D'Auction de Ruffe was
killed in May 1941 and other lawyers asked a fee of Dollar 2.000.-I am
not a rich man and could not pay such fees.But it was the duty of the
Emigrants' Committee to defend Russian children.It should have summoned
Reimann to the Court,/ the penalty for pederasty is 17 years imprisonment/,
and to exclude him from the Committee.But the Emigrants Committee
failed to do so. This criminal is still working in the Remy School,not
with standing that by the decree of the French Court he was dismissed
from the School on 28th February 1941.
I have the honour to inform your Excellency that I was excluded from the
lists by Mr.Serestmikoff out of personal revenge,afraid that I would start
against him a prosecution for concealing Reiman's crimes and also,I think,
because he thought that my mention that I was not imprisoned in Shanghai
as a hint on his,Serestmikoff's imprisonment in 1930- 1931,by a Court-
decision in the Ward Road Gaol,for being one of the organisers of Roulette
/a forbidden gamblency/ in the Russian Association, Mr.Serestmikoff
remained in prison one month,for the second he paid a fine.

被委员会置之不理；而且，作为Reiman犯罪的证据，我向委员会提交了雷米学校被Reiman强奸的俄国男孩向法国法官提供的证词副本，在法庭审理结束后，这些证词由我的律师D'Auction de Ruffé先生退还给我。
我仍然保留着这些证词。在我的信件登记簿中，我有侨民委员会的所有收据，证明我的所有陈述和证词均已为委员会所接收。但是，无论是Ivanoff先生，还是Serestmikoff和Savintzeff先生，都没有站出来保护俄国儿童免受俄国罪犯Reiman的侵害，Reiman于1941年4月4日因通过一名17岁男孩Skobin（孤儿）实施强奸而被中国法庭传唤。法庭仅对案件进行了一半的审理。Reiman先生作了证，但法庭终止了程序，因为Skobin未成年且是孤儿。在法庭的决定中，法官指出，如果我的监护人文件得到最高法院的批准，此案可以由我本人，即Frisovsky，继续起诉。
我无法起诉，因为我的律师D'Auction de Ruffe于1941年5月去世，而其他律师索要2,000美元的费用。我不是富人，付不起这样的费用。但保护俄国儿童是侨民委员会的职责。它本应将Reimann传唤至法庭（鸡奸罪的刑罚是17年监禁），并将其从委员会除名。但侨民委员会未能这样做。这名罪犯仍在雷米学校工作，尽管根据法国法院的法令，他已于1941年2月28日被学校开除。
我有幸告知阁下，我是被Serestmikoff先生出于个人报复而从名册中除名的，他害怕我会就他隐瞒Reiman的罪行对他提起诉讼；此外，我认为还因为他认为我提及自己未在上海入狱是在暗示他，Serestmikoff，因作为俄国协会中轮盘赌（一种被禁止的赌博）的组织者之一，于1930-1931年被法院判决关押在提篮桥监狱（Ward Road Gaol）。Serestmikoff先生服刑一个月，第二次则支付了罚款。

3.
Wishing to tarnish my name, Mr. Sereshnikoff used provocation, to get
rid of me and to clear his way of me, because I possess against him-
self and the committee proofs of accusing character.
I am living in Shanghai for about 20 years as a Russian Emigrant. I
am an officer of the Imperial Russian Army, I am a Monarchist, an
Anti-Communist and Fascist. I do not drink or smoke. I am 61. During
8 years I was a sport's instructor and head educator. I retired in 1940
because for 7 years I did not get any salary for the sports, and another
person got it instead of myself; and also because of Reiman. By the
Court's decission I got my salary and Reiman -his dismissal.
I still remain an officer of the Great Russian Army, I did not lose my
military honour nor my virtue. I am devoted to His Imperial Majesty
the Emperor of Great Japan whose Army in 1920 in Chabarovsk, on the
4th to 5th April saved my life, (I have the document) having liberated
me together with 440 others from a Bolshevist prison which all were
sentenced to death. Thanks to the Great Japanese Army I had 20 more
years of life, and therefore I love the Emperor of Japan limitlessly,
his chivalorous people, and am willing to offer my life for the sake
of the Great Japanese People.
Therefore I, a little Russian man and Russian officer, honest and staight,
am asking your Excellency's kind assistance in calling in and examination
in connection with my complaint, and that all the concerned documents
in my possession should also be examined.
I never was a Bolshevik or a Socialist and the whole Russian Colony in
Shanghai knows me for the last 20 years as well as other nations, as an
honest worker and a loyal person.
I beg of you, your Excellency, to reinstate my rights of Russian Emigrant
and to allow me to keep my Registration Book Nr. 2122. I received it on
the 2nd May a.c. and indicate to the Mayor of the Greater Shanghai that
I did not commit any crime, political or other. And also, I would like
in the future to receive my passport directly from the Bureau of Pass-
ports and reinstall my rights of an honest emigrant.
At the same time I ask your kind interference in defence of poor children
of the Rémy-School against this abominable criminal pederast Reiman, who
due to the concealment of the Committee can continue his base activity in

为了抹黑我的名声，Sereshnikoff先生使用挑衅手段，以摆脱我并清除我这个障碍，因为我掌握着针对他本人和委员会的具有指控性质的证据。
我作为一名俄国侨民在上海生活了大约20年。我是前俄罗斯帝国军队的军官，我是君主主义者、反共主义者和法西斯主义者。我不喝酒也不吸烟。我今年61岁。在8年间，我担任体育教练和首席教育家。我于1940年退休，因为在7年里我没有拿到任何体育工作的薪水，而是由另一个人领取；同时也因为Reiman的缘故。根据法院的决定，我拿到了薪水，而Reiman则被解雇。
我仍然是大俄罗斯军队的军官，我没有失去我的军人荣誉或美德。我效忠于大日本帝国皇帝陛下，他的军队于1920年4月4日至5日在哈巴罗夫斯克（Chabarovsk）救了我的命，（我有文件证明）将我和其他440人从布尔什维克监狱中解放出来，我们当时都被判处死刑。多亏了大日本帝国军队，我又活了20年，因此我无限热爱日本皇帝，热爱他英勇的人民，并愿意为大日本人民献出我的生命。
因此，我，一个渺小的俄国人和俄国军官，诚实正直，恳请阁下垂怜协助，就我的投诉进行传唤和审查，并审查我所持有的所有相关文件。
我从来不是布尔什维克或社会主义者，过去20年里，上海整个俄国侨民界以及其他各国人士都了解我，知道我是一名诚实的工作者和忠诚的人。
我恳请阁下恢复我作为俄国侨民的权利，并允许我保留我的登记簿第2122号。我于今年5月2日收到该登记簿，并向大上海市长表明，我没有犯下任何政治或其他罪行。此外，我希望将来能直接从护照处领取我的护照，并恢复我作为诚实侨民的权利。
同时，我恳请阁下介入，保护雷米学校（Rémy-School）的贫困儿童免受这个可恶的鸡奸罪犯Reiman的侵害，由于委员会的包庇，他得以在学校继续其卑鄙的活动，

page_data.en:
Translation of a leading article which appeared in Russian
Newspaper "THE NEW LIFE" on 26/7/42. Published by Mr. K.
LUKIN, 409 East Howard Road. Editor - Mr. P.A. AVINOFF

Today's order of the Russian
Emigrants Committee

The Russian Emigrants Committee's order, which is published
today, regarding the striking off the Committee's Register of
two Russian emigrants is a measure, the necessity of which was
discussed during the last year. But, if there were not a few
public workers at that time who were against such a drastic
measure, the new persons have now voted their approval of the
necessity of applying this extreme punishment. A person struck
off the Committee's Register forfeits the right for legal defence
on the part of Russian emigrant organizations, is excluded from
the Russian emigrant community. Such a measure is taken with
the knowledge and approval of the Authorities with whom the
Russian emigrant community maintains friendly and business contact
through the medium of the Russian Emigrants Committee. A person
who is struck off the Committee's Register literally becomes an
individual outside the society of Russian Emigrants.

It is cruel, but absolutely necessary measure. There are
persons in our midst who do not listen to any reasons and keep on
saying that everybody is wrong and that only they are right. Such
people pay no attention to the fact that an overwhelming majority
of public workers disapprove of their activities. Such people
act under the cover of high ideas and discredit these ideas more
than anybody else. Such people obstruct the organization of a
more or less normal life, cause dissension and thereby constitute
disintegrating factors.

In the name of protection and unity of the Russian emigrant
community drastic repressive measures are absolutely necessary.
We are living in war time and in the war time circumstances.
Therefore the Russian emigrant community too is obliged to act
in its inner life in accordance with the spirit of the present
time. It must not consider itself as something which is living
its own independent life, but as a power participating in the
common work for the benefit of both the Russian emigrant communi-
ty and those creative forces which are building up new life
based on the principles of new order.

The Russian Emigrants Committee is an institution to which
in the first place both individual Russian emigrants and emigrant
organizations are subordinated. No Russian emigrant can engage in
any public work here, if it is not approved by the Russian
Emigrants Committee, if the activities of this or that emigrant
are not coordinated with the Russian Emigrants Committee. This
is a fundamental rule, and this rule has been violated by the
persons whose striking off the Committee's Register is now
announced.

Subordination of Russian emigrants to all orders issued by
the Russian Emigrants Committee must be compulsory, be it only by
virtue of the fact that all such orders are always issued with
the approval of the authorities. All these orders are dictated
not by personal impulses of members comprising the Russian
Emigrants Committee, but by motives of principles. Their aim is
common benefit, common welfare. It is high time to set all
ceremonies aside in dealing with those who do not understand this.
This is made imperative by the present historic moment through
which the whole world is now passing including Russian emigrants,
a part of whom is the Russian Emigrant community in Shanghai.

27/7/42.

译自1942年7月26日俄文报纸《新生活报》（THE NEW LIFE）刊登的一篇社论。出版人：K. LUKIN 先生，地址：霍华德路409号。编辑：P.A. AVINOFF 先生

今日俄国侨民委员会之命令

今日公布的俄国侨民委员会关于将两名俄国侨民从委员会名册中除名的命令，是一项其必要性在去年就已讨论过的措施。但是，如果当时有一些社会活动人士反对这种严厉措施的话，现在这些人也已投票赞成实施这种极端惩罚的必要性。被从委员会名册中除名的人，即丧失由俄国侨民组织提供法律辩护的权利，并被排除在俄国侨民社群之外。采取此项措施已征得当局知情并批准，俄国侨民社群通过俄国侨民委员会这一媒介与当局保持着友好及事务性联系。被从委员会名册中除名的人， literally（字面上）成为俄国侨民社会之外的个人。

这是一项残酷但绝对必要的措施。在我们中间有这样一些人，他们听不进任何理由，坚持说别人都错了，只有他们是对的。这些人无视绝大多数社会活动人士不赞成他们的活动这一事实。这些人打着崇高理想的幌子行事，却比任何人都更严重地败坏这些理想的名声。这些人阻碍了或多或少正常生活的组织，引起不和，从而构成了瓦解因素。

为了保护俄国侨民社群并维护其团结，严厉的镇压措施是绝对必要的。我们生活在战时及战时环境中。因此，俄国侨民社群也有义务使其内部生活符合当前时代的精神。它不应将自己视为过着独立生活的实体，而应视为一股参与共同工作的力量，旨在造福俄国侨民社群以及那些基于新秩序原则建设新生活的创造性力量。

俄国侨民委员会是一个机构，首先，个别俄国侨民及侨民组织均须受其管辖。如果没有得到俄国侨民委员会的批准，如果某位侨民的活动未与俄国侨民委员会协调，任何俄国侨民都不能在此从事任何社会工作。这是一条基本规则，而现在宣布将其从委员会名册中除名的人员违反了这条规则。

俄国侨民必须服从俄国侨民委员会发布的所有命令，这必须是强制性的，至少因为所有这些命令都是在当局批准下发布的。所有这些命令并非由组成俄国侨民委员会的成员的个人冲动所驱使，而是出于原则性的动机。其目的是共同利益和共同福利。对于那些不理解这一点的人，现在是时候抛开一切礼节了。当今世界（包括俄国侨民，其中上海俄国侨民社群是其一部分）正在经历的历史时刻使这种做法成为当务之急。

1942年7月27日。

ШАНХАЙ, 26 ІЮЛЯ 1942 ГОДА
Сегодняшній приказ Р.Э.К.
Публикуемый сегодня приказ Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета о снятіи с эмигрантскаго учета двух россійских эмигрантов есть мѣра, о необходимости которой вопрос поднимался еще в прошлом году. Но если в прошлом году было не мало общественных дѣятелей, которые были против этой крутой мѣры, то теперь и эти лица точно также высказались за необходимость примѣненія этой «высшей мры наказанія». Снятый с учета лишается правовой защиты россійских эмигрантских учрежденій и организацій, исключается из семьи россійской эмигрантской колоніи. Это исключеніе согласуется с тѣми властями, с которыми россійская эмигрантская колонія через Россійскій Эмигрантскій Комитет поддерживает дѣловой и дружескій контакт. Снятый с учета становится в буквальном смыслѣ слова человком внѣ общества россійских эмигрантов.
Мѣра жестокая, но мѣра абсолютно необходимая. Есть в нашей средѣ не мало людей, у которых хоть коса на головѣ темна, а они продолжают утверждать, что дѣло не в ногу идут, а только они — в ногу. Эти люди не обращают вниманія на то, что подавляющее число общественников относится к их дѣятельности отрицательно. Эти люди, прикрываясь высокими идеями, прежде всего и больше всего сами же эти идеи дискредитируют. Эти люди мѣшают налаживанію болѣе или менѣе нормальной жизни, вносят раздор и этим самым дѣйствуют разлагающе.
Въ тѣх случаях, когда россійское общество проявляло строгость, репрессивныя мѣры принимались лишь против тѣх, кто своими дѣйствіями подрывал авторитет россійской эмиграціи, кто своим поведеніем компрометировал ее перед лицом других народов. Въ таких случаях россійское общество руководствоваться духом времени, разсматривать себя не как нѣчто, живущее в хатѣ с краю, а как силу, вовлеченную в общую работу, выполняющую в планѣ этой работы дѣло, полезное как россійской эмигрантской колоніи, так и тѣм творческим силам, которыя строят новую жизнь на принципах новаго порядка.
Россійскій Эмигрантскій Комитет является учрежденіем, которому в шанхайской обстановкѣ прежде всего и больше всего подчиняются как отдѣльные россійскіе эмигранты, так и цѣлыя эмигрантскія организаціи. Ни один россійскій эмигрант не может вести здѣсь какой либо общественной работы, если на то нѣт согласія Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета, если вопрос о дѣятельности того или иного эмигранта не согласован с Россійским Эмигрантским Комитетом. Это — основное правило, и оно нарушено лицами, об исключеніи которых с эмигрантскаго учета сегодня сообщается.
Подчиненіе россійских эмигрантов всѣм распоряженіям Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета должно быть обязательным хотя бы только потому, что эти распоряженія всегда и обязательно согласованы с властями. Всѣ эти распоряженія диктуются не личными, субъективными побужденіями лиц, в Р. Э. Комитетѣ сидящих, а будущими принципами важнаго, объективнаго порядка. Цѣль этих распоряженій — общее благо, общая польза. И с тѣми, кто этого не понимает, пора перестать церемониться. К этому обязывает историческій момент, переживаемый всѣм міром, переживаемый, въ частности, и россійской эмиграціей. Пора, наконец, понять, что время индивидуальных выступленій прошло, что настало время коллективной работы, время организованной дѣятельности.

上海，1942年7月26日
今日俄国侨民委员会之命令
今日公布的俄国侨民委员会关于将两名俄国侨民从侨民登记册中除名的命令，是一项其必要性在去年就已提出的问题。但是，如果在去年有不少社会活动人士反对这项严厉措施，那么现在这些人也同样表示支持实施这种“最高刑罚”的必要性。被从登记册中除名的人，将失去俄国侨民机构和组织的法律保护，并被排除在俄国侨民殖民地大家庭之外。这一除名决定是与当局协商一致的，俄国侨民殖民地通过俄国侨民委员会与当局保持着事务性和友好接触。被从登记册中除名的人，字面意义上成为了俄国侨民社会之外的人。
这是一项残酷但绝对必要的措施。在我们中间有不少人，尽管头脑不清（原文俗语直译：虽然头上的辫子是黑的，意指糊涂或固执），但他们继续声称事情进展不顺，只有他们是正确的。这些人不注意这样一个事实，即绝大多数公众人物对他们的活动持否定态度。这些人打着崇高理想的幌子，首先且最主要的是他们自己败坏了这些理想的名声。这些人妨碍了或多或少正常生活的建立，制造纷争，从而起到瓦解作用。
在俄国社会表现出严格性的情况下，镇压措施仅针对那些以其行动破坏俄国侨民威望、以其行为在其他民族面前损害俄国侨民声誉的人。在这种情况下，俄国社会以时代精神为指导，不将自己视为生活在边缘小屋中的某种存在，而是视为一股卷入共同工作的力量，在这项工作计划中执行既有利于俄国侨民殖民地，又有利于那些基于新秩序原则建设新生活的创造性力量的事业。
在上海的环境下，俄国侨民委员会是一个机构，个别俄国侨民以及整个侨民组织首先且最主要地受其管辖。如果没有俄国侨民委员会的同意，如果某位侨民的活动问题未与俄国侨民委员会协调，任何俄国侨民都不能在这里开展任何社会工作。这是一条基本规则，而今天通报的被从侨民登记册中除名的人员违反了这一规则。
俄国侨民服从俄国侨民委员会的所有指令必须是强制性的，至少因为这些指令总是且必然与当局协调一致。所有这些指令并非由坐在俄国侨民委员会中的人的个人主观动机所驱使，而是由重要的、客观秩序的未来原则所决定。这些指令的目的是共同福祉、共同利益。对于那些不理解这一点的人，是时候不再客气了。全世界正在经历的历史时刻要求这样做，特别是俄国侨民也在经历这一时刻。最后是该明白的时候了，个人行动的时代已经过去，集体工作、有组织活动的时代已经到来。

Chief of Foreign Department of the S.M.C.

Mr. Yamaguchi, Chief of the Foreign Department, S.M.C.,
visited the offices of the Russian Emigrants Committee dur-
ing office hours yesterday. He was accompanied by Inspector
Maklaevsky, who is in charge of Russian Section of the Depart-
ment, and who introduced Mr. Yamaguchi to the Chairman of the

of the local Russian community and the activities of the
Russian Emigrants Committee.

Russian Emigrants Committee that a higher representative of
the Municipal Authorities deemed it possible to get first
hand information direct from an emigrant institution subor-
dinated to the Municipal Authorities.. Messrs British did
not condescend to this, despite the fact that Russian commu-

日本人访问侨民组织

昨日，一群以 Ehiра 上校为首的著名日本人访问了俄罗斯侨民委员会。访问的目的是了解委员会的工作。陪同访问者的是黑木先生，他向客人介绍了俄罗斯侨民委员会主席 N. K. Serezhnikov。

离开委员会后，客人们在委员会成员 P. A. Savintsev 的陪同下，前往各个俄罗斯侨民组织。在此次巡视期间，黑木先生向日本人介绍了每个被访组织的负责人和工作情况。

离开委员会后的第一个访问地点是伤残军人联盟。联盟负责人向客人展示了印刷厂、图书馆、宿舍以及他们丰富的军事博物馆，其中一些罕见的展品引起了在场者的极大兴趣。

从伤残军人联盟出发，客人前往奥尔金斯基收容所，在那里受到了阿里亚德娜修女院长的接待，她向客人介绍了整个庞大且模范的院所设施。在收容所的教堂里，阿里亚德娜修女院长向客人展示了稀有的、经过修复的圣像，并简要讲述了它们的历史和修复过程。在收容院的院子里，一群孩子——修道院母亲抚养的女学生——聚集在一起。

访问的第三个地点是仁慈之家。仁慈之家的 V. S. Tsypkin 亲自迎接了来访者，并展示了仁慈之家的所有房间。

离开仁慈之家后，客人前往商业学校，该校校长 Pokrovsky 带领参观者参观了所有班级。遗憾的是，当时部分学生正在参加教堂礼拜，教室里也没有满员。在圣吉洪·扎东斯基收容所的教堂礼拜中，也有该收容所的学生在场，参观者登上二楼，即收容所所在地，仅查看了收容所的房间。

离开商业学校后，一行人前往俄罗斯医院。医院院长 N. A. Smirnov 博士迎接了参观者，并带领他们参观了整个医院，向他们介绍医院的工作、设备以及两栋住院楼中各个病房的用途。

最后一次访问的是公共食堂。N. Yu. Fomin 和 Golovachev 教授在此迎接了来访者。此时食堂正好开始分发午餐。客人参观了厨房，了解其运作情况。食堂大厅里临时为客人摆好了餐桌，并向他们提供了当时正分发给用餐者的午餐。午餐完全满足了客人的要求，他们在感谢食堂管理方的热情款待后，乘车前往虹口。

遗憾的是，由于时间不足，未能访问其他一些俄罗斯侨民机构和组织，但对上述机构的访问几乎全面展示了俄罗斯侨民社区的生活，达到了此次出行的目的。

1942年5月21日，一群以 Ehiра 上校为首并由 K. KUROKI 先生陪同的著名日本人访问了俄罗斯侨民委员会及其他俄罗斯侨民组织，以了解其活动情况。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
10 MAR. 1942
Russians In
City Meet On
Many Issues
Local Russian emigre
associations and organiza-
tions opened a grand confer-
ence to discuss outstanding
problems and principles yes-
terday in the premises of the
Sokol Club under the auspices
of the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, it was learnt.
Archbishop Victor opened the
meeting with a religious service, and
stressed in his talk that while the
world was marching victoriously
along the road of the New Order,
the basic principles of that 'Order
were shared warmly by Russian
patriots.
The Archbishop called on Rus-
sian emigres to give active help
to the struggles being carried on by
the forces of the New Order, and
stated that the conference should
do its share in reshaping local Rus-
sian communal life.
Mr. N. Serejnikov, a Colonel of
the Russian Tsarist Army, made a
speech stressing that all outstanding
problems will be solved on the
basis of Russian national interests.
Professor M. P. Golovachev,
commenting on behalf of the Rus-
sian Central Committee, declared
that poverty among local Russian
emigres is becoming a communal
crisis, while Dr. N. P. Molchaov
described the "catastrophic" situa-
tion which exists in regard to
medical aid to indigent Russians.
The meeting, which laid the basis
for a detailed conference, was at-
tended by representatives of the
Japanese and Chinese authorities.

市内俄国人
就诸多议题
举行会议
据悉，昨日在俄罗斯侨民委员会的主持下，当地俄罗斯侨民社团和组织在“索科尔”俱乐部会所召开了一次大型会议，讨论突出问题和原则。
维克多大主教 (Archbishop Victor) 以宗教仪式开启会议，并在讲话中强调，当世界正沿着“新秩序”的道路胜利前进时，俄罗斯爱国者热烈认同该“秩序”的基本原则。
大主教呼吁俄罗斯侨民积极帮助“新秩序”力量正在进行的斗争，并表示会议应在重塑当地俄罗斯社区生活方面发挥其作用。
前俄罗斯沙皇军队上校 N. 谢列日尼科夫 (N. Serejnikov) 先生发表演讲，强调所有突出问题都将基于俄罗斯民族利益得到解决。
M. P. 戈洛瓦切夫 (M. P. Golovachev) 教授代表俄罗斯中央委员会发言称，当地俄罗斯侨民中的贫困现象正成为一场社区危机，而 N. P. 莫尔恰诺夫 (N. P. Molchaov) 博士描述了贫困俄罗斯人医疗援助方面存在的“灾难性”状况。
日本和中国当局代表出席了此次为详细会议奠定基础的会议。

S. 3, Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date March 9, 1942.
SUBJECT: Meeting of the Russian Associations in Shanghai

Russian Emigrants Committee called a meeting of representatives of various Russian Emigrants Associations in Shanghai, which was held during the afternoon of March 8th, 1942 at the premises of Russian Sporting Association "Sokol" 888 Weihaiwei Road.

The meeting was called for the purpose of discussing various problems confronting Russian Emigrants in Shanghai. The meeting was opened by Col. Serejnikoff, chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee, who after short speech appointed Col. P.A. Vedeniapin, as honorary chairman of the meeting.

Col. Vedeniapin assured Col. Serejnikoff, that he will do his best. as a chairman of new organised body, and invited all members of the organisations represented in this new committee for sincere cooperation to solve Russian emigrants problems in Shanghai. Then heads of various departments of Russian Emigrants Committee outlined the works and condition of Russian community in Shanghai.

1. Mr. P.A. Savintzeff - Outlined cultural and education life of Russian Emigrants in general.
2. I.E. Tsumanenko - Education in the Russian white community.
3. Prof. M.P. Golovacheff- Outlined the work of Central Benevolent Committee.
4. Mr. M.C. Molchanoff - Russian Hospital.
5. Mr. Masloff - Outlined the work of Finance and Economic Dept. of Russian Emigrants Committee.

主题：上海俄罗斯社团会议

俄罗斯侨民委员会召集了上海各俄罗斯侨民协会代表会议，该会议于1942年3月8日下午在威海卫路888号俄罗斯体育协会“索科尔”会所举行。

召开会议的目的是讨论上海俄罗斯侨民面临的各种问题。会议由俄罗斯侨民委员会主席谢列日尼科夫上校 (Col. Serejnikoff) 主持开幕，他在简短致辞后任命韦杰尼亚平上校 (Col. P.A. Vedeniapin) 为会议名誉主席。

韦杰尼亚平上校向谢列日尼科夫上校保证，他将尽最大努力履行这一新组建机构主席的职责，并邀请参与该新委员会的各组织成员真诚合作，以解决上海俄罗斯侨民的问题。随后，俄罗斯侨民委员会各部门负责人概述了上海俄罗斯社区的工作和状况。

1. P.A. 萨温采夫 (P.A. Savintzeff) 先生 - 概述了俄罗斯侨民的整体文化和教育生活。
2. I.E. 楚马年科 (I.E. Tsumanenko) - 俄罗斯白人社区的教育。
3. M.P. 戈洛瓦切夫 (M.P. Golovacheff) 教授 - 概述了中央慈善委员会的工作。
4. M.C. 莫尔恰诺夫 (M.C. Molchanoff) 先生 - 俄罗斯医院。
5. 马斯洛夫 (Masloff) 先生 - 概述了俄罗斯侨民委员会财政经济部的工作。

Торжественнаго открытія Совѣщанія при Россійскомъ Эмигрантскомъ Комитетѣ
города Шанхая.

Воскресенье 8 марта 1942 г. в 3 часа дня

Зал гимнастическаго общества „Русскій Сокол“ 888 Вейхайвей род.

1. Слово Высокопреосвященнаго Владыки Виктора перед началом молебна.
2. Молебен при участіи соборнаго хора.
3. Слово Преосвященнаго Владыки Іоанна послѣ молебна.
4. Открытіе Совѣщанія Предсѣдателемъ Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета,
объясняющим цѣли и задачи Совѣщанія и, затѣм, передающим предсѣдатель-
ствованіе на Совѣщаніи П. А. Веденяпину.
5. Слово П. А. Веденяпина, как Предсѣдателя Совѣщанія.
6. Доклад Начальника Культурно - Просвѣтительнаго отдѣла Р. Э. Комитета,
П. А. Савинцева.
7. Доклад Начальника Школьнаго отдѣла Р. Э. К-та И. Е. Цюманенко.
8. Доклад Центральнаго Благотворительнаго Комитета.
9. Доклад Предсѣдателя Общества медицинских работников, д-ра Н. П. Молчанова.
10. Доклад Финансово-Экономическаго отдѣла Р. Э. Комитета.
11. Заключительное слово Предсѣдателя Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета,
Н. К. Сережникова.
12. Закрытіе торжественнаго засѣданія Совѣщанія.
page_data.zh:
议程
上海俄罗斯侨民委员会协商会议隆重开幕

1942年3月8日，星期日，下午3时

地点：威海卫路888号“俄罗斯索科尔”体操协会大厅

1. 维克多尊座大主教 (Highly Reverend Lord Victor) 在祈祷仪式开始前致辞。
2. 在大教堂唱诗班参与下举行祈祷仪式。
3. 约翰尊座主教 (Reverend Lord John) 在祈祷仪式后致辞。
4. 俄罗斯侨民委员会主席宣布协商会议开幕，解释会议的目标和任务，随后将会议主持权移交给 P. A. 韦杰尼亚平 (P. A. Vedeniapi)。
5. P. A. 韦杰尼亚平 (P. A. Vedeniapi) 作为会议主席致辞。
6. 俄罗斯侨民委员会文化教育部主任 P. A. 萨温采夫 (P. A. Savintsev) 作报告。
7. 俄罗斯侨民委员会学校部主任 I. E. 丘马年科 (I. E. Tsyumanenko) 作报告。
8. 中央慈善委员会作报告。
9. 医务工作者协会主席 N. P. 莫尔恰诺夫 (N. P. Molchanov) 博士作报告。
10. 俄罗斯侨民委员会财政经济部作报告。
11. 俄罗斯侨民委员会主席 N. K. 谢列日尼科夫 (N. K. Serejnikov) 致闭幕词。
12. 协商会议隆重会议闭幕。

SHANGHAI TIMES

5 MAR. 1942

Russian Bodies To
Discuss Problems
At Joint Meeting

Representatives of all local
Russian emigré organizations
will meet to discuss current
problems at 3 p.m. on Sunday
in the hall of the Sokol Club,
888 Weihaiwei Road, it was
announced yesterday.
The meeting which will be
preceded by a religious cere-
mony, presided over by Arch-
bishop Victor and Bishop John,
will be informed of the work
being carried out by various
departments of the Russian
Emigrants' Committee as well
as of plans made by the body
to better the Russian emigré
community's life.

（批：53. e
6. 3 H2
6/0
D. S. Krehetoff

sfd.）

《字林西报》

1942年3月5日

俄罗斯团体将
在联合会议上
讨论问题

昨日宣布，当地所有俄罗斯侨民组织的代表将于周日下午3时在威海卫路888号“索科尔”俱乐部大厅集会，讨论当前问题。
此次会议将在由维克多大主教 (Archbishop Victor) 和约翰主教 (Bishop John) 主持的宗教仪式之后进行，与会者将获悉俄罗斯侨民委员会各部门正在开展的工作，以及该机构为改善俄罗斯侨民社区生活所制定的计划。

The following notification of the Cultural and
Educational Section of the Russian Emigrant Committee
appeared in the "New Times", March 11th., 1942.

（批：5082A）
（批：No 7-4-2）

К СВЕДЕНИЮ РАБОТНИКОВ ИСКУССТВА
Настоящим Культурно-Просветительный
отдел Р. Э. К. и Правление Содружества Ху-
дожников, Литераторов, Артистов, Музыкан-
тов доводят до сведенья зарегистрирован-
шихся работников искусства, что общія
собранія для выборов руководящих аппара-
тов объединеній состоятся в пятницу 13
марта по следующему расписанію:
1. Собраніе музыкантов—в Русском Об-
щественном Собраніи в 10 часов утра.
2. Собраніе писателей и журналистов—в
Русском Общественном собраніи в 10 часов
утра.
3. Собраніе Художников в Русском Об-
щественном собраніи в 10 часов утра.
4. Собраніе артистов балета в театрѣ
„Лисеум“ в 12.30 дня.
5. Собраніе артистов драмы, оперы и
оперетты в Русском Общественном собраніи
в 4 часа дня.
Всѣ вышеозначенныя собранія начнутся
точно в указанное время.

（印：FILE 11-3. 42）

The workers of the art to note.

The cultural and education section of the Russian
Emigrant Committee and the Board of associations of
Painters, Writers, Artists, Mussians hereby are notifying the s
registered members of art that the general meetings for elec-
tion of leading apparatus of associations will take place
on Friday, March 13th. on the following schedule :
1) The meeting of musicians - in Russian Social
Club, 1053 Avenue Foch, at 10 a.m.
2) The meeting of writers and jurnalists in Russian Social
Club at 10 a.m.
3) The meeting of painters in Russian Social Club at 10a.m.
4) The meeting of artists of Ballet in Lycéum Theatre
at 12.30 p.m.
5) The meeting of artists of drama, opera and light
opera in Russian Social Club at 4 p.m.
All abovementioned meetins will begin sharply at the
times stated.

（签名）
A. Albagui
D. S. I.
S. 3, Special Branch
Officer i/c Special Branch.

THE "SHANGHAI ZARIA" and "NEW TIMES"
FEBRUARY 20,1942

NOTICE No.4
of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai

CONSTITUTION OF THE ADVISORY BODY OF THE R.E.C.

A. In conformity with Article 7 of the Statute of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai notice is hereby given concerning the formation of the Advisory Body attached to the Russian Emigrants Committee,the first solemn meeting of which will be held on Sunday March 8, 1942 in the hall of the Russian Sporting Association "Sokol".

B. The Russian Emigrants Committee calls upon members of the Russian emigrant community to carry out,between now and March 1,1942,certain measures as stated below in order to effect complete unification of members of the Russian community in the existing organizations, as well as their representation in the Advisory Body:-

(1). Colonel P.A. Vedeniagin will unify around the Russian Ex-Service Men Association all emigrant organizations of military,military-educational and sporting character and form an organ unifying and directing the activities of such organizations. This group of organizations will be represented in the Advisory Body by four delegates headed by Colonel P.A. Vedeniagin.

(2). The Union of Cossacks in Shanghai unifying members of all Russian Cossack Troops will delegate two representatives to the Advisory Body.

(3) The Committee of the Russian Military Invalids' Union in Shanghai will delegate one representative.

(4) The Russian Central Charity Committee unifying all charitable organizations will delegate four representatives to the Advisory Body headed by Mr. N.U. Fomin, President of the R.C.C.Committee.

(5) The Russian Chamber of Commerce, which is at present carrying out registration of all commercial and industrial enterprises in conformity with notice dated 27-12-41,reminds all Russian emigrants,who are owners of various commercial and/or industrial enterprises, of the necessity to register at the Russian Chamber of Commerce.
The Russian Chamber of Commerce and those who are registered with it will send four representatives to the Advisory Body headed by Mr. P.S. Grigorieff, President of the R.C.C.

俄文译文。

《上海柴拉报》和《新时代》
1942年2月20日

第4号通知
上海俄国侨民委员会

俄国侨民委员会咨询机构的组成

A. 根据《上海俄国侨民委员会章程》第7条，兹通告成立附属于俄国侨民委员会的咨询机构，其首次正式会议将于1942年3月8日（星期日）在俄国体育协会“索科尔”（Sokol）大厅举行。

B. 俄国侨民委员会呼吁俄国侨民界成员在即日起至1942年3月1日期间，执行下述措施，以实现现有组织中俄国社区成员的完全统一，并确立其在咨询机构中的代表权：-

(1). P.A. Vedeniagin（韦杰尼亚金）上校将围绕俄国退伍军人协会，统一所有具有军事、军事教育和体育性质的侨民组织，并形成一个统一和指导此类组织活动的机构。该组织群体将在咨询机构中由四名代表组成，由P.A. Vedeniagin（韦杰尼亚金）上校率领。

(2). 上海哥萨克联盟统一了所有俄国哥萨克部队的成员，将委派两名代表参加咨询机构。

(3) 上海俄国伤残军人联合会委员会将委派一名代表。

NOTICE No. 4

CONSTITUTION OF THE ADVISORY BODY OF THE R.E.C.

A. In conformity with Article 7 of the Statute of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai notice is hereby given concerning the formation of the Advisory Body attached to the Russian Emigrants Committee, the first solemn meeting of which will be held on Sunday March 8, 1942 in the hall of the Russian Sporting Association "Sokol".

B. The Russian Emigrants Committee calls upon members of the Russian emigrant community to carry out, between now and March 1, 1942, certain measures as stated below in order to effect complete unification of members of the Russian community in the existing organizations, as well as their representation in the Advisory Body:-

(1). Colonel P.A. Vedeniapin will unify around the Russian Ex-Service Men Association all emigrant organizations of military, military-educational and sporting character and form an organ unifying and directing the activities of such organizations. (2). The Union of Cossacks in Shanghai unifying members of all Russian Cossack Troops will delegate two representatives to the Advisory Body.

(3) The Committee of the Russian Military Invalids' Union in Shanghai will delegate one representative.

Составъ Совѣщанія при Россійскомъ
Эмигрантскомъ Комитет
Объявленіе Комитета № 4-й

А. В соотвтствіи с пунк том 7 Положенія о Россійском Эмигрантскомъ Комитетѣ горо да Шанхая объявляется объ учрежденіи Совѣщанія при Россійскомъ Эмигрантскомъ Ко митетѣ, первое торжественное засѣданіе котораго назначает ся на воскресенье 8-го мар та с. г. въ залѣ гимнастиче скаго общества «Русскій Со кол».

В. Въ срокъ до 1-го марта Россійскій Эмигрантскій Коми тет предлагает членам Рос сійской эмигрантской коло ніи провести нижеслѣдующія мѣропріятія съ цѣлью полнаго объединенія членовъ Россій ской эмигрантской колоніи въ существующих организаціях и всеобъемлющаго представи тельства их въ Совѣщаніи:

1. Полковнику П. А. Ве леняпину провести объедине ніе около Союза служивших въ Россійских Арміи и Флотѣ всѣх эмигрантских организа цій военнаго, спортивнаго и вѣенно - воспитательнаго ха рактера, создавъ объединенный аппарат, руководящій жизнью и дѣятельностью объединяе мых организацій. От этого объединенія въ Совѣщаніе ко мандируется четыре предста вителя во главѣ съ Полковни ком П. А. Веленяпиным.

2. Объединяющій всѣ ка заки Россійских казачьих войск Казачій Союз въ Шан хаѣ выдѣляет из своего со става двух представителей въ Совѣщаніе.

3. От Правленія Шанхай скаго Отдѣла Союза Инвали дов въ Совѣщаніе делегируется один представитель.

4. Объединяющій всѣ бла готворительныя организаціи Центральній Благотворитель ный Комитет делегирует въ Со вѣщаніе четырех представите лей во главѣ съ предсдателем Ц. В. Комитета Н. Ю. Фоми ным.

5. Русская Торговая Па лата, проводящая въ настоя щее время регистрацію всѣх торгово - промышленных пред пріятій на основаніи объявле нія от 27-го декабря 1941 го да напоминаеть всѣмъ Россій скимъ эмигрантамъ предприни мателямъ о необходимости оформить регистрацію въ Торго вой Палатѣ до 1-го марта. От Русской Торговой Палаты и всего состава зарегистриро ванных въ Совѣщаніе делегиру ется четыре представителя во главѣ съ П. Ф. Григоровым.

6. Начиная съ 23-го сего февраля въ Россійскомъ Эми грантскомъ Комитет должны зарегистрироваться всѣ Рос сійскіе эмигранты — меди цинскіе работники (врачи, фармацевты, фельдшера, фельдшерицы, акушерки, се стры милосердія, зубные вра чи и техники). Регистрація должна быть закончена въ суб боту 28-го февраля и въ вос кресенье 1-го марта въ помѣ щеніи Россійскаго Эмигрант скаго Комитета назначается общее собраніе зарегистри ровашнихся медицинских ра ботников, на каковом избира ется Правленіе Объединенія медицинских работников. Из состава этого объединенія въ Совѣщаніе делегируется два представителя.

7. На основаніи представ ленных на утвержденіе Рос сійскому Эмигрантскому Коми тета основных положеній о реорганизаціи Содружества Художников, Литераторов, Артистов и Музыкантов та ковое Содружество переимено вывается въ Россійское Обще ство Служителей Искусства въ Эмиграціи, предсѣдателем ко тораго назначается Началь ник Культурно - Просвѣти тельнаго Отдла Эмигрантска го Комитета. Общество соста вляется на слѣдующих объеди неній: а) Объединеніе писа телей и журналистов, б) Объ единеніе артистов драмы, опе ры и оперетты, в) Объедине ніе артистов балета и г) Объ единеніе музыкантов. Руково дители каждаго объединенія вмѣстѣ съ предсѣдателем Обще ства составляют Правленіе Общества.

Всѣ Россійскіе эмигранты, работающіе въ той или иной области искусства, или свя занные съ искусствомъ и прош лой своей дѣятельности, долж ны быть зарегистрированы въ соотвтствующемъ объединеніи согласно послѣдующих объяв леній о мѣстѣ и времени та ковой регистраціи.

От Общества въ Совѣщаніе командируются два представи теля, из которых один должен быть из членов Объединенія писателей и журналистов.

8. Въ существующемъ Об ществѣ Русских Педагогов (предсѣдатель А. Е. Цыков) подлежат зарегистрироваться всѣм Россійским эмигрантам, занимающимся педагогиче ской дѣятельностью и от ука заннаго Общества въ Совѣща ніе делегируется один пред ставитель.

9. Въ Русском Обществѣ Общественных Бухгалтеров и Счетоводов должны зарегист рироваться всѣ Россійскіе эми гранты, занимающіеся контор ским трудом, и от этого Об щества въ Совѣщаніе делеги руется два представителя во главѣ съ Б. И. Залѣсоким.

10. Въ Русском Техниче ском Обществѣ надлежит за регистрироваться всѣм Россій ским эмигрантам инженерам, техникам и чертежникам. Два представителя во главѣ съ А. Г. Чибунновским будут представлять это Общество въ Совѣщаніи.

11. Въ Русском Юридиче ском Обществѣ (Предсѣда тель И. Е. Помазенко) долж ны зарегистрироваться всѣ практикующіе юристы и от Общества въ Совѣщаніе деле гируется один представитель.

12. Всѣ служащіе въ торго во - промышленных предпрія тіях, не входящіе въ состав членов вышеуказанных орга низацій, должны зарегистри роваться въ Обществѣ служа щих Торгово - Промышлен ных предпріятій (предсѣда тель Д. Т. Кадомцев) и от Общества въ Совѣщаніе де легируется два представите ля.

13. Всѣ Россійскіе эми гранты, служащіе почтовы ми, телеграфными и морскими гардами, должны зарегистри роваться въ Обществѣ почта льонов, боцманов и морских гардов (предсѣдатель Я. И. Аксеновъ). От Общества деле гируется въ Совѣщаніе три представителя во главѣ съ предсѣдателем Общества.

14. Церковный Благотво рительный Комитет, съ благо словенія Епископа Іоанна, делегирует въ Совѣщаніе од ного представителя.

15. Члены Особаго Мань чжурскаго Отряда (ОМО) де легируют въ Совѣщаніе одного представителя.

16. Идеологическій Центр делегирует въ Совѣщаніе одно го представителя.

17. Національно - Духов ная Община Тюрко Татар делегирует въ Совѣщаніе одно го представителя.

18. Общество Россійских эмигрантов евреевъ делегирует въ Совѣщаніе двух представи телей.

В. Всѣ вышеуказанныя объединенія и организаціи должны представить въ Рос сійскій Эмигрантскій Коми тет списки делегатов въ Совѣ щаніе не позднѣе 3-го мар та, для представленія Мэру Великаго Шанхая для утверж денія.

Г. Предсѣдателем Совѣща нія Россійскій Эмигрантскій Комитет признает полковни ка П. А. Веленяпина, замѣ стителем его секретаря Со вѣщанія.

上海俄国侨民委员会咨询会议组成
委员会公告第4号

A. 根据《上海俄国侨民委员会章程》第7条，兹宣布成立俄国侨民委员会咨询会议，其首次隆重会议定于本年3月8日星期日在“俄罗斯索科尔”体育协会大厅举行。

B. 俄国侨民委员会提议，俄国侨民团成员须在3月1日前采取以下措施，旨在完全统一现有组织中的俄国侨民团成员，并使其在咨询会议中获得全面代表权：

1. P.A. Velenyapin（韦列尼亚平）上校负责围绕曾在俄国陆军和海军服役者联盟，联合所有具有军事、体育和军事教育性质的侨民组织，建立一个统一机构，指导被联合组织的生活和活动。从该联合体中，将委派四名代表参加咨询会议，由 P.A. Velenyapin（韦列尼亚平）上校率领。

2. 联合所有俄国哥萨克军队的上海哥萨克联盟，从其成员中选出两名代表参加咨询会议。

3. 上海伤残军人联盟分会理事会向咨询会议委派一名代表。

4. 联合所有慈善组织的中央慈善委员会向咨询会议委派四名代表，由中央慈善委员会主席 N.Yu. Fomin（福明）率领。

5. 俄国商会目前正在根据1941年12月27日的公告对所有工商企业进行登记，特此提醒所有俄国侨民企业家务必在3月1日前完成在商会的登记手续。从俄国商会及所有已注册成员中，将委派四名代表参加咨询会议，由 P.F. Grigorov（格里戈罗夫）率领。

6. 自本月23日起，所有俄国侨民医疗工作者（医生、药剂师、医士、女医士、助产士、护士、牙医和牙科技师）必须在俄国侨民委员会登记。登记工作须于2月28日星期六结束，并于3月1日星期日在俄国侨民委员会所在地召开已登记医疗工作者的全体会议，会上将选举产生医务工作者联合会理事会。从该联合会中，将向咨询会议委派两名代表。

7. 根据提交俄国侨民委员会批准的关于重组艺术家、文学家、演员和音乐家联谊会的基本规定，该联谊会更名为“俄国侨民艺术工作者协会”，由侨民委员会文化教育科科长担任主席。该协会由以下联合会组成：a) 作家和记者联合会，b) 戏剧、歌剧和轻歌剧演员联合会，c) 芭蕾演员联合会，以及 d) 音乐家联合会。各联合会负责人与协会主席共同组成协会理事会。

所有从事艺术领域工作或过去曾从事与艺术相关工作的俄国侨民，必须根据后续关于登记地点和时间的公告，在相应的联合会进行登记。

从该协会中，将向咨询会议委派两名代表，其中一人必须来自作家和记者联合会成员。

8. 所有从事教育活动的俄国侨民必须在现有的俄国教师协会（主席 A.E. Tsykov（齐科夫））登记，并从该协会向咨询会议委派一名代表。

9. 所有从事办公室工作的俄国侨民必须在俄国公共会计师和簿记员协会登记，并从该协会向咨询会议委派两名代表，由 B.I. Zalesky（扎列斯基）率领。

10. 所有俄国侨民工程师、技术员和绘图员必须在俄国技术协会登记。两名代表将由 A.G. Chibunnovsky（奇布诺夫斯基）率领，代表该协会参加咨询会议。

11. 所有执业律师必须在俄国法律协会（主席 I.E. Pomazenko（波马岑科））登记，并从该协会向咨询会议委派一名代表。

12. 所有在工商企业任职且不属于上述组织成员的雇员，必须在工商企业雇员协会（主席 D.T. Kadomtsev（卡多姆采夫））登记，并从该协会向咨询会议委派两名代表。

13. 所有担任邮政、电报和海事警卫职务的俄国侨民，必须在邮递员、水手长和海事警卫协会（主席 Ya.I. Aksenov（阿克谢诺夫））登记。从该协会向咨询会议委派三名代表，由协会主席率领。

14. 教会慈善委员会在 Ioann（约翰）主教的祝福下，向咨询会议委派一名代表。

15. 特别满洲支队（OMO）成员向咨询会议委派一名代表。

16. 意识形态中心向咨询会议委派一名代表。

17. 突厥-鞑靼民族精神社区向咨询会议委派一名代表。

18. 俄国犹太侨民协会向咨询会议委派两名代表。

V. 上述所有联合会和组织必须不迟于3月3日向俄国侨民委员会提交咨询会议代表名单，以便呈报大上海市长批准。

G. 俄国侨民委员会认定 P.A. Velenyapin（韦列尼亚平）上校为咨询会议主席，并为其配备咨询会议秘书作为副手。

（右侧竖排文字）
1942年2月18日
M. YANOVICH（亚诺维奇）。

N. SEREZHNikov（谢列日尼科夫）上校。

Ioann（约翰）主教。
俄国慈善委员会主席

《新时报》，1942年2月18日

俄国侨民委员会就伟大胜利致以祝贺

俄国侨民委员会怀着真诚的喜悦和深深的满意之情，代表由本委员会联合的俄国侨民，向在上海的日本国代表致以祝贺，庆祝日本帝国军队占领太平洋上的英国堡垒——新加坡要塞。
这一胜利是日本伟大精神的胜利，这种精神是由日本国父和最高领袖——天皇——所培育的。通过这一胜利，帝国日本完成了其在东亚历史使命中的主要任务之一。
上海俄国侨民委员会

俄国侨民委员会就日军占领新加坡一事向在上海的日本国代表发出的贺信。

档案：俄国侨民委员会。

ginning from this date a centrally situated registration
point will function at the offices of the Russian Emigrants

daily ( Saturdays - between 9 a.m. and 12 noon ).

RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS COMMITTEE
AND
FORCES OF NEW ORDER

Between 7 p.m. and 10 p.m. on 31-1-42 a dinner party
was held by the Russian Emigrants Committee at the Palace Hotel
on the occasion of confirmation of Colonel N.K. SEREJNIKOFF as
Chairman of the Committee.

Apart from members of the committee in corpore
(Messrs Serejnikoff, Kochneff, Tsumanenko, Lang, Vertoprahoff, Kors-
neff, Jakovkin and Savintseff) 25 persons attended the function.
including the following named gentlemen:-

Colonel KUBOTA          Japanese Military Mission
Mr. AMAI                do
Mr. MATSUSITA           Japanese Embassy
Mr. SAKABE              Japanese Consulate-General
Mr. IKEMI               do
Mr. KUROKI

Mr. TAKANAGI            do
Mr. OGAWA

Mr. LEE                 Secretary, Peace Preservation
                        Corps

Mr. OHAN (?)            Headquarters, Peace Preserva-
                        tion Corps.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH）

（批：FILE / H.2.42）

In addressing his guests Colonel SEREJNIKOFF inter
alia said:-
" Allow me to take the opportunity of this gather-
ing and ask you to convey to the heads of your respective depart-
ments on behalf of myself and all Russian emigrants our most re-
spectful and profound gratitude for the invariable consideration
and support granted to us, thanks to which we can live in East
Asia in accordance with the dictates of our Russian soul and
mind educated in the spirit of nationalism and patriotism, in
the spirit of ideals of pre-revolutionary Russia.

I take the liberty of assuring you that the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee and the Russian emigrant community uni-
fied by the Committee appreciate the hospitality granted to us,
and constant considerate attitude towards our material and spiri-
tual needs, sympathise with the enormous and responsible task,
which you are at present carrying out in East Asia, and are fully
prepared to be of service to your great cause, the cause of estab-
lishing New Order in East Asia.

I shall be glad if to-night's gathering will help
in the establishment of firm ties, based on mutual trust, bet-
ween the Russian Emigrants Committee and the institutions in
which you have the honour of carrying out responsible work and

“请允许我借此聚会之机，代表我本人及所有俄国侨民，恳请诸位向各自部门的主管转达我们最崇高、最深切的感激之情，感谢你们给予我们始终如一的关照与支持。得益于此，我们得以在东亚生活，遵循我们在民族主义和爱国主义精神熏陶下形成的俄罗斯灵魂与思想，秉承革命前俄罗斯的理想精神。

我冒昧向各位保证，俄国侨民委员会以及由该委员会团结起来的俄国侨民社群，珍视给予我们的款待，以及对我们物质和精神需求持续不断的体贴关怀；我们对你们目前在东亚所承担的艰巨而负责任的任务表示同情与支持，并完全准备为你们的伟大事业——即在东亚建立新秩序的事业——效力。

如果今晚的聚会有助于在俄国侨民委员会与诸位荣幸地在此承担重要工作的各机构之间，建立起基于相互信任的牢固联系，我将感到十分高兴。

Воскресенье, 1 февраля 1942 г. № 3 (567)

Р. Э. К. и Силы Новаго порядка

Вчера в 7 часов вечера в «Палас отелѣ» состоялся ужинъ, устроенный Россійскимъ Эмигрантскимъ Комитетомъ по случаю утвержденія въ должности Предсѣдателя Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета полковника Н. К. Сережникова.

Цль этого ужина была исчерпывающе выражена въ рѣчи Н. -К. Сережникова, привѣтствовавшаго собравшихся слѣдующими словом:
«Какъ Предсѣдатель Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета, я имѣю честь отъ имени всей Россійской Эмигрантской Колоніи, Комитетомъ объединяемой, поблагодарить Васъ, господа, за то, что Вы выразили желаніе и нашли время для того, чтобы за этимъ столомъ раздѣлить съ нами хлѣбъ-соль.
Пользуясь этимъ случаемъ я позволю просить Васъ передать Вашимъ возглавителямъ мою и всѣхъ насъ, Россійскихъ эмигрантовъ, почтительную и глубочайшую благодарность за то неизмѣнное вниманіе и всяческую поддержку, которыя мы постоянно имѣемъ и благодаря которымъ можемъ жить въ Восточной Азіи такъ, какъ повелѣваетъ наша русская душа и нашъ русскій разумъ, воспитанные въ національно - патріотическомъ духѣ, въ духѣ дореволюціонныхъ россійскихъ идеаловъ.
Используя сегодняшнее наше общеніе за этимъ столомъ я смѣю Васъ завѣрить, что Россійскій Эмигрантскій Комитетъ и объединяемая имъ Россійская Эмигрантская Колонія, благодарная за оказанное намъ гостепріимство, признательная за постоянное вниманіе къ нашимъ духовнымъ и матеріальнымъ нуждамъ и глубоко сочувствующая той огромной и отвѣтственной работѣ, которую Вы на пространствѣ Восточной Азіи въ данный историческій моментъ проводите, въ полной мѣрѣ готова быть полезной Вашему великому дѣлу, дѣлу установленія Новаго Порядка на Восточно - Азіатскомъ пространств.
И я буду глубоко радъ, если сегодняшнее наше торжество послужитъ къ тому, чтобы установить крѣпкую, основанную на полномъ взаимномъ довѣріи связь Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета съ тѣми учрежденіями, въ которыхъ Вы имѣете честь вести отвѣтственную работу и въ сношеніяхъ съ которыми Россійскій Эмигрантскій Комитетъ находится.
Поднимая первый тостъ за успѣшное завершение Вашего великаго дѣла, въ Вашемъ лицѣ благодаря за довѣріе, оказанное мнѣ назначеніемъ на постъ Предсѣдателя Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета, пью за Ваше здоровье, господа».
Кром членовъ Россійскаго Эмигрантскаго Комитета «ин корпорез» (г., Сережниковъ, Кочневъ, Цюманенко, Лангъ, Вертопраховъ, Кореневъ, Яковкинъ, Савинцевъ, на ужинѣ присутствовали: подполковникъ Кубота, (отъ японской военной миссіи), г. Сакабе (отъ японскаго ген. консульства), г. Куроки, г. Мацусита (отъ японскаго посольства), г. Икеми (отъ японскаго генеральнаго консульства) г. Тянъ (отъ консульства Маньчжу-го), г. Ли, (секретарь штаба китайскихъ охранныхъ войскъ), г. Кимура (отъ О-ва Ко-а-имъ), г. Амада (отъ японской военной миссіи), г. Цзянъ (отъ штаба китайскихъ охранныхъ войскъ), г. г. Ямомото и Таканаги (отъ яп. жандармскаго управленія), г. г. Огава, Томару и мн. др. въ числѣ 25 человѣкъ. Ужинъ прошелъ въ атмосферѣ непринужденнаго веселья, среди котораго, помимо цѣлаго ряда офиціальныхъ тостовъ, большимъ успхомъ пользовалась русская «чарочка», и закончился въ 11 часу.
Цѣнно въ этомъ ужинѣ-банкетѣ то, что впервые за все время существованія въ Шанхаѣ россійской Эмигрантской колоніи за столомъ объединялись представители россійской эмиграціи съ представителями тѣхъ властей, отъ которыхъ зависитъ существованіе россійской эмиграціи, какъ единаго идеологическаго цѣлаго.
